title: Mobblocker Plugin
description: Disable certain mobs / animals on the server.
body:
This plugin allows you to disable certain mobs. These will then no longer spawn. All mobs that are still alive will not be killed without the command /mobblocker kill.

There are 3 commands. All three require operator by default, permission plugins are compatible: mobblocker.admin.

- /mobblocker reload

Reloads the config file.

- /mobblocker list

Lists all blocked mobs.

- /mobblocker kill

Kills all mobs that are blocked server-wide.
